schema.name: Edit mode
schema.description: Allow users to edit node properties from views and persist changes to the underlying data.

schema.name: View modes
schema.description: Choose which layout types can be created when building views (Graph, Hierarchy, Context View, Layered Lineage).

schema.name: Signup
schema.description: Allow new users to create an account from the login page (self-registration).

schema.name: Trace
schema.description: Enable lineage trace in graph and context views (trace upstream/downstream from a node).

schema.name: Non-admin editing
schema.description: Allow non-admin users to create, edit, and publish semantic layers. When disabled, only admins can manage semantic layer definitions.
schema.adminHint: Enable this to let team members define their own semantic layers without admin intervention. They can still only edit draft layers they created.

schema.name: Export
schema.description: Allow users to export semantic layer definitions as JSON files for backup, migration, or sharing between environments.

schema.name: Auto-suggest from graph
schema.description: Enable the 'Suggest from Graph' feature that automatically generates semantic layer definitions by analyzing the entity and relationship types in the connected data source.

schema.name: Version history & audit trail
schema.description: Show the full version history and audit trail for each semantic layer, including who made changes, when, and what was modified.

schema.name: Edit mode
schema.description: Allow users to enter edit mode on semantic layer definitions to modify entity types, relationships, hierarchy, and other structural settings.
schema.adminHint: When disabled, semantic layers are read-only for all users. Admins can still publish, clone, and export.

schema.name: Import
schema.description: Allow users to import semantic layer definitions from exported JSON files. Supports creating new layers or updating existing ones with change detection and version management.
schema.adminHint: Disable if you want to restrict semantic layer changes to the UI editor only, preventing bulk imports.

schema.name: Version control
schema.description: Drafts, reviews, publishing, history and rollback for data sources. When off, all version-control tools are hidden and canvases are view-only. Existing history is kept and stays safe.
schema.adminHint: Turning this off hides version control for every user and makes editing unavailable. Background sync of already-versioned data keeps running, and nothing is deleted.

schema.name: Announcements
schema.description: Show global announcement banners to all users. When disabled, banners are hidden even if active announcements exist.
schema.adminHint: Toggle off to instantly hide all announcement banners without deactivating individual announcements.
